events.title: Foro Marino de Ibiza y Formentera
events.desc: A day of talks on the Mediterranean, the blue economy and conservation, closing at 20:00 with a concert by Felt Oxytocin and live painting by Cristina Reina.

events.title: Sunset sessions at Hostal La Torre — last week
events.desc: Daily live music and DJs on the clifftop terrace as the sun goes down, through Sunday 25 October. The last chance this year.

events.title: Book launch: Dones de la Sal, now in English
events.venue: Biblioteca Vicent Serra i Orvay, Sant Jordi
events.desc: Esperança Marí presents the English and Spanish editions of her book on the women of the salt pans.

events.title: dTAPASxIBZ — tapas route through Ibiza Town
events.desc: Until Sunday 25 October: each venue serves a signature tapa and the public votes for the winner. A good excuse to wander Vila's back streets.

events.title: The Path of Yoga at Atzaró
events.desc: A 90-minute yoga session in the gardens with optional Yoga Nidra, relaxation and spa access afterwards.

events.title: Ibiza Vinyl Club
events.desc: Vinyl-only DJs in the café garden, Thursday evenings.

events.title: Tardeo entre sopranos — opera, laughs and good company
events.desc: A relaxed, funny opera concert by two sopranos. Nothing stiff about it.

events.title: Olive-salting workshop at an old olive press
events.desc: Learn the traditional Ibizan way of curing olives in salt with Cristina Ferrer, inside a historic farmhouse press. Two sessions: 16:30 and 18:00.

events.title: Autumn stories for children — Library Day
events.desc: Storytelling and a small exhibition to celebrate Library Day.

events.title: Sunset and moonrise walk at Cala Comte
events.desc: A guided evening walk with the Es Vedrà and Illots de Ponent nature-reserve team: sunset over the islets, then the moon rising.

events.title: A night in the library — family stories and songs
events.venue: Biblioteca Vicent Serra i Orvay, Sant Jordi
events.desc: Evening storytelling and songs for families.

events.title: Eivissa Clàssica: Los Mundos Idealizados
events.venue: Sala Capitular, Ajuntament d'Eivissa, Dalt Vila
events.desc: Chamber concert around Mussorgsky, Rimsky-Korsakov and Grieg in the town hall's old chapter house.

events.title: Friday cinema: Hard Truths (Mike Leigh)
events.desc: Original version with Spanish subtitles. Free until the room is full.

events.title: Sant Rafel fiestas: night walk, sobrassada barbecue and folk concert
events.desc: The village's patron-saint week warms up with a night walk, a torrada of sobrassada and a concert by Arredefolk. Hot chocolate and buñuelos for the kids in the afternoon.

events.title: Ibiza Trail Marathon Festival
events.desc: 48 km marathon at 07:30, 28 km at 08:30 and an 11 km starter at 10:00, out along the coast and through the hills. Entries are closed — go and cheer.

events.title: Decorative ceramics painting workshop
events.venue: Museu Etnogràfic Can Ros, Puig de Missa
events.desc: Paint traditional Ibizan decorative ceramics with Celia Casanova. Ages 16+.

events.title: One Last Summer Dance — free open-air day party
events.venue: Parc Reina Sofía & Baluard de Sant Pere, Dalt Vila
events.desc: House and disco DJs on two stages under the walls, celebrating Ibiza Spotlight's 50th birthday. After-party at Teatro Pereyra from midnight.

events.title: Supernova at Las Dalias
events.desc: Garden DJs from the afternoon, free until 22:00, then the club.

events.title: Renaissance polyphony inside the MACE installation
events.desc: Ensemble Cristóbal de Morales sings Palestrina, Guerrero, Brudieu and Flecha inside Stefan Brüggemann's golden installation Cel d'Or.

events.title: Choir gathering: four choirs at Puig de Missa
events.desc: Trobada de Corals Lina Bufí — four island choirs including the Eivissa Gospel Choir, in the fortified hilltop church.

events.title: Festes de Sant Rafel — patron saint's day
events.desc: Mass and procession, ball pagès by Sa Colla de Sant Rafel, tasting of traditional products, then concerts into the night (Esta me la sé, Morning Drivers, DJ Yor D). The real island, in one village square.

events.title: Sunday social walk with Ibiza Outdoors
events.desc: The island's long-running community walk (formerly Walking Ibiza). Donation-based, all levels.

events.title: The origins of Dalt Vila — guided heritage walk
events.desc: Two hours through the Phoenician and Punic beginnings of the town, ending at the Sant Pere bastion.

events.title: Big second-hand market in Jesús
events.desc: Village flea market on the church square until 16:30.

events.title: Aire Arte — open-air art walk
events.desc: Local artists show and sell along the seafront promenade.

events.title: Nido summer closing
events.desc: The last garden session of the season; free in the garden until 22:00.

events.title: Cala Escondida closing party — live music on the beach
events.desc: The eco beach bar at the quiet end of Platja d'en Bossa closes its season with Soul Doctor playing live from 18:30, cocktails and the sea as backdrop. Last chance this year.

events.title: Choir gathering at Santa Creu
events.desc: Three island choirs in concert.

events.title: Halloween reading and writing workshop for kids
events.venue: Biblioteca Vicent Serra i Orvay, Sant Jordi
events.desc: With Rosario Ferrer. Also at 17:30: a children's reading workshop at the Sant Josep library.

events.title: Wednesdays are PURE — midweek walk
events.desc: Ibiza Outdoors' weekly Wednesday walk. Donation-based.

events.title: Punta Arabí hippy market — last day of the season
events.desc: The Wednesday market closes for winter after today. Back in spring.

events.title: HIC Summit — slow food and sustainable tourism
events.desc: Opening session of a three-day summit on sustainable tourism, with a slow-food culinary experience. Further sessions 29 Oct at TheHub and 30 Oct at Colegio Mestral.

events.title: Ibiza Halloween Festival opens
events.desc: Four days of horror and fantasy films, FX make-up workshops and the Terror Express one-minute phone-film contest, through Sunday 1 November.

events.title: Halloween double bill: Weapons & The Monkey
events.venue: Can Jeroni (Sant Josep) and Auditori Caló de s'Oli (Cala de Bou)
events.desc: Two horror films in original version, one in each venue. Check the start time with the council — listings vary between 20:00 and 21:30.

events.title: Guided coastal walk from Sant Carles (14 km)
events.desc: Cala Mestella, Cala Boix and Pou des Lleó on an advanced-level walk with the municipal tourism team.

events.title: Halloween: monster make-up and the Monster Walk
events.venue: Vara de Rey and the streets of Vila
events.desc: Free monster make-up from 17:00, then the costume parade through town ending on a red carpet with prizes. The island's biggest Halloween night for families.

events.title: Coco, el musical: Recuérdame
events.desc: Día de Muertos family musical, ages 3+. Second show Sunday at 12:00.

events.title: Dreams 2 (Sueños) — dance theatre
events.desc: Armin Heinemann's tango-butoh production.

events.title: Stargazing night at the Cala d'Hort observatory
events.venue: Observatori de ses Païsses, Cala d'Hort
events.desc: Telescope session under one of the darkest skies on the island, with a free bus. Ages 6+. Places by email 23–25 October.

events.title: Halloween at Pikes — the haunted hotel
events.desc: Costume compulsory, charity night, until 06:00. Pikes also hosts The Haunted Ballroom at 528 Ibiza with Erol Alkan and Leon Vynehall.

events.title: Tots Sants children's fiesta and trencada
events.desc: Nut-cracking, workshops and bouncy castles for All Saints' Day, lunch at the football ground, and the Trencada de Tots Sants at 20:00 to close the fiestas.

events.title: Podenc Race — pairs obstacle race
events.desc: A hybrid race in pairs with ten challenges, named after the island's hunting dog.

events.title: Nido x Día de Muertos
events.desc: Day of the Dead edition; free in the garden until 20:00.

events.title: Theatrical visit to the old cemetery
events.desc: An All Saints' tour of the old cemetery with actors telling its stories.

events.title: Festes de Sant Carles — patron saint's day
events.desc: Mass and procession at midday, ball pagès, a hippy market in the afternoon and music into the night. 2026 programme still to be published — times follow last year's pattern.

events.title: Festival del Humor: Comandante Lara
events.desc: Opening night of the island's comedy festival. In Spanish. Also 6 Nov Isabel Rey, 7 Nov Rubén García, 8 Nov Perdido en los 80.

events.title: Friday cinema: A Real Pain (Jesse Eisenberg)
events.desc: Original version with Spanish subtitles.

events.title: Dalt Vila's landmark buildings — guided heritage walk
events.venue: Meet at Plaça de la Catedral
events.desc: Two hours on the civil, military and religious architecture of the old town.

events.title: Supernova at Las Dalias
events.desc: Free in the café until 23:00, then the club.

events.title: Sant Carles Xtrem — obstacle race
events.desc: Spartan-style obstacle race on a 1.2 km closed circuit, categories for all ages, kids free. Register by 5 November.

events.title: Choir gathering in Sant Josep
events.desc: Three island choirs in the village church, followed by vermouth hour on the square.

events.title: Nido at Las Dalias
events.desc: Sunday garden session, free until 20:00.

events.title: Cinefòrum UIB: Gattaca — film and debate
events.desc: The university's free film forum: a film in original version, then a debate. Next: Persona on 13 Nov, Smoke on 27 Nov.

events.title: Last day to enrol: free Spanish classes, Santa Eulària
events.desc: Bring passport or NIE and your padrón. Classes run Monday and Wednesday from October to April, mornings in Santa Eulària and evenings in Jesús.

events.title: Choir gathering in Sant Antoni — four choirs in the church
events.desc: The Consell's Trobada de Corals Lina Bufí moves west: the parish choir of Sant Antoni, Cor de ses Figueretes, the Ukrainian Greek Catholic church choir and Cor Ciutat d'Eivissa, one after the other in the big church on the square. Free until the pews are full.

events.title: Choir gathering in Sant Joan — the northern parishes sing
events.venue: Església de Sant Joan de Labritja
events.desc: The choirs of Sant Joan, Sant Llorenç and Sant Vicent together, with Santa Gertrudis, Puig d'en Valls and the young voices of Cor de Veus Joves. The village church, a Saturday evening in November, and a drink at the bar after.

events.title: Closing concert of the choir gathering — 50 years of Amics de sa Música
events.venue: Església de Santo Domingo (El Convent), Dalt Vila
events.desc: The island's choir series ends in the convent church in Dalt Vila with Cor Amics de sa Música celebrating its 50th anniversary. Free; arrive early, it fills.

recurring.title: Las Dalias Saturday market
recurring.desc: The famous market, 200+ stalls, every Saturday until 28 November, then the Christmas market in December.

recurring.title: Sant Jordi flea market
recurring.desc: Year-round second-hand, antiques, records and clothes; drummers around midday.

recurring.title: Forada market
recurring.desc: Small year-round market of local produce and crafts: honey, cosmetics, ceramics, vegetables.

recurring.title: Sant Joan Sunday market
recurring.desc: Artisan and organic market with live musicians from midday, all year.

recurring.title: Farmers' market at sa Cooperativa
recurring.desc: Island growers sell direct on Friday mornings.

recurring.title: Free group run from the port
recurring.desc: Running Ibiza's social 7 km run, every Saturday until May. Time can shift — check their page each week.

recurring.title: Guided trail run
recurring.desc: Running Ibiza's guided trail run with Donna, through May.

recurring.title: Ibiza Outdoors group walks
recurring.desc: Sunday social walk and the midweek 'Wednesdays are PURE'. Formerly Walking Ibiza. All levels.

recurring.title: Original-language cinema at Teatro España
recurring.desc: Films in their original language four evenings a week until 13 December.

recurring.title: Live music at Cas Costas
recurring.venue: Cas Costas, Ctra Sant Josep km 3
recurring.desc: Acoustic and jazz nights every Thursday of the year, with the grill going.

recurring.title: Can Jordi Blues Station
recurring.desc: Blues and rock gigs at the island's most loved roadside bar, all year.

recurring.title: Can Rich winery tour and tasting
recurring.desc: Vineyard walk, three wines and a hierbas to finish.

recurring.title: Stefan Brüggemann: Cel d'Or
recurring.desc: A gold, site-specific installation filling the old armoury. Tuesday to Sunday.

recurring.title: Picarol: 150 years
recurring.desc: 66 satirical drawings and posters by the Ibizan cartoonist. Mon–Fri 10–13:30 and 17:30–20:30, Sat mornings.

recurring.title: Hans Grass: I al mar, els somnis
recurring.desc: Paintings in the small museum on Carrer Major. Tuesday to Sunday.

recurring.title: Julia Delgado López: Landscapes of the World
Ned Irving: In The Flow
recurring.desc: Paintings in the art café next to the Saturday market.

recurring.title: Free Spanish classes for EU residents — Santa Eulària town hall
recurring.venue: Santa Eulària (by the Club Nàutic) mornings · Jesús cultural centre evenings
recurring.desc: The town hall's own Spanish course for foreigners: beginner, intermediate and advanced, twice a week, free. Mornings in Santa Eulària (08:30 / 09:30 / 10:30), evenings in Jesús (17:00 / 18:00). Enrol by 31 October with passport or NIE and your padrón; tel. 971 33 96 69.

recurring.title: Live piano over lunch at Sa Caleta
recurring.desc: A pianist through the long lunch, Thursday to Saturday, at the fish restaurant on the red-cliff beach. Order the bullit de peix the day before. Free with lunch.

recurring.title: The Yard — vinyl, open decks and the fireplace at Las Dalias Café
recurring.desc: Reggae, soul and dub on vinyl, open decks for whoever brings records, tapas and the fire going. The north's Thursday living room.

recurring.title: Salsa & bachata Sundays at Keeper
recurring.desc: The island's Latin crowd dances on Sunday nights all year, led by Evelyn 'La Negra', who also runs classes on Mondays and Tuesdays. Beginners welcome; sometimes a free class first.

recurring.title: Latin Club at Zazú — salsa and bachata
recurring.desc: Salsa and bachata the first half of the night, then whatever the floor wants. €15 with a drink.

recurring.title: Zinètic — independent cinema in original version
recurring.desc: The west's winter film club: independent films in original language with subtitles, Friday nights at the old Regio.

upcoming.title: Learn to shuck oysters — with The Oyster Nomad
upcoming.desc: An afternoon with the travelling oysterman: how to open an oyster without losing a finger (or the liquor), how to tell a good one, and what to drink with it — AIX rosé from Provence, poured generously. You leave knowing how to shuck, and well fed. Small group.

upcoming.title: Dawn walk up Sa Talaia with Sant Josep council
upcoming.desc: The council's free guided walks start the season with sunrise from the island's highest point. Arrive 30 minutes early, no dogs. Next: Ses Salines–Es Codolar 13 Dec, full-moon Es Cavallet 23 Jan, Sant Agustí 21 Feb, Es Cubells 21 Mar.

upcoming.title: Festes de Santa Gertrudis — patron saint's day
upcoming.desc: Mass and procession in the morning, ball pagès on the square, a concert in the marquee at 20:00, and the bars full. The fiestas run into early December with the world rice-with-pebrassos contest and the Cursa de sa Sobrassada on the last weekend of November.

upcoming.title: Festa des Vi Pagès — the Sant Mateu wine festival
upcoming.desc: The village pours its new wine for free, with sobrassada and butifarra from the matances, ball pagès at 19:00 and a concert after. Always the second Saturday of December. The one day a year the whole island drives to Sant Mateu.

upcoming.title: Divendres de Cine — free films in original version at Can Jeroni
upcoming.desc: Sant Josep's winter film cycle: a film every Friday night in original version with subtitles, free, January to March.

upcoming.title: Sant Josep és Música — a month of concerts in the village bars
upcoming.venue: Can Jordi, Rosana's, Cas Costas and more
upcoming.desc: Every January the municipality fills its bars with music: Can Jordi Blues Station Thursdays and Saturdays, Rosana's on Saturdays, Cas Costas Thursdays, improvisation Wednesdays at Robert Arató's studio. Programme at musica.santjosep.org.

upcoming.title: Festes de Sant Antoni — blessing of the animals and the big tasting
upcoming.desc: Mass, procession, the blessing of every dog, horse and parrot in the west, ball pagès and a popular tasting on the promenade. The fiestas run 9 January to mid-February; the world matances-rice championship is on Carrer Rosell around 6 February — sign up at Bar Es Clot.

upcoming.title: Festes de Santa Agnès — bunyols, carts and the almond blossom
upcoming.desc: Mass at 12:00, a parade of carts, ball pagès, free bunyols and wine, a concert at 19:00. The weekends that follow: the sofrit pagès contest, a night walk through the blossom around 30 January, the Cursa dels Ametllers in early February. The prettiest village fiesta on the island.
